problemSignature.symptom: A report claims verified production bindings while the actual KiCad schematic and PCB still contain BF_CONN and ReviewRequired proof assets.

rootCause: The manufacturing gate validated files, ERC/DRC, exports, sourcing, and hashes but did not prove that canonical symbol, footprint, and pin-map bindings were projected into the KiCad sources being validated.
fixSummary: Fail closed unless every BOM reference has an exact MPN and verified production assets whose symbol, footprint, and pad-net map match the actual KiCad project.

testsAdded: verified report cannot smuggle BF_CONN review assets through manufacturing acceptance
valid projected production symbol, footprint, and pad-net map permits acceptance

conditions: Any manufacturing acceptance or autonomous board campaign

recipe: Require exact verified MPN, production symbol, production footprint, and verified pin map for every populated reference.
Parse the actual schematic and PCB used by KiCad validation and compare each reference against its binding.
Pass normalized productionAssetBindings into every board-class manufacturing pipeline invocation; never rely on a separate report that the gate cannot inspect.
Reject BF_CONN, ReviewRequired, proof, and placeholder assets regardless of optimistic report status.
Run adversarial mismatch and valid-projection regressions before accepting a board.
safetyRules: A separate canonical binding report is not proof that a binding was projected into KiCad.
ERC/DRC zero on a review abstraction cannot establish manufacturing readiness.
Previously accepted checkpoints must be revalidated when acceptance semantics become stricter.

before.status: BF_CONN and ReviewRequired projects could be marked MANUFACTURING_ACCEPTED

after.status: actual per-reference symbol, footprint, and pad-net projection is mandatory
